entries.jp: {v:0053}ちょっとアンタ、{n}今の話をみんなに知らせるのが先決でしょう！
{v:0054}お兄ちゃん、まだ屋敷を調べてないよ？
{v:0055}どこへ行こうってのよ。まったく‥‥。
{v:0056}まだ屋敷を調べてませんけど？
{v:0057}ほらほら、戻った戻った。
{v:0058}あれ？{n}お兄さま、まだ屋敷を調べてないけど？
{v:0059}まだ屋敷を調べてないけどいいのかい？
{v:0052}ちょっとアンタ、{n}まだ情報収集がすんでないでしょうが！
{v:00ED}ここじゃ話せねぇんだ。{n}すぐに宿に行こうぜ。
entries.en: {v:00ED}Can't talk here. Let's get to the inn now.

entries.jp: {v:0000}やっと着いたわね。{n}通行手形ってここまでしか来られないんでしょ？
entries.en: {v:0000}Finally, we're here! Our travel permit only gets us this{n}far, right?

entries.jp: {v:0001}そう言ってたよね。{n}とりあえず場所は覚えたから、{n}テレポートは大丈夫だよ。
entries.en: {v:0001}That's what they said, right? I've memorized this place{n}now, so I can use Teleport to get us here.

entries.jp: {v:0002}それで、ここから先はどうする？
entries.en: {v:0002}So, what do we do from here?

entries.jp: {v:0003}これから先はどうするのですか？
entries.en: {v:0003}How shall we proceed from here?

entries.jp: {v:0004}でもここから先はどうすんの？
entries.en: {v:0004}But what do we do now?

entries.jp: {v:0005}そう言えば、関所の衛兵が気になることを{n}言っていたな。
entries.en: {v:0005}Come to think of it, that checkpoint guard said{n}something that bothered me.

entries.jp: {v:0006}気になること‥‥。{n}何だっけ？{p}{v:0007}アンタ、覚えてる？
entries.en: {v:0006}Something that bothered you...? What was it again?{p}{v:0007}Do you remember?

entries.jp: ウォレスのいう『気になること』とは{n}何だと思いますか？
entries.en: What do you think Wallace meant by 'something that{n}bothered me'?

entries.jp: ・街で問題を起こすなと注意された事
entries.en: ・Being told not to cause trouble in town

entries.jp: ・街にバーンシュタイン兵がいる事
entries.en: ・Burnstein soldiers being in town

entries.jp: ・思い出せない
entries.en: ・I can't remember

entries.jp: {v:0008}そうは言っていましたけど‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0008}He did say that, but...

entries.jp: {v:0009}たしかにそう言ってはいましたね。
entries.en: {v:0009}Yes, he certainly did say that.

entries.jp: {v:000A}そんなこと、言ってたね。
entries.en: {v:000A}He did say something like that.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:000B}だが俺が言っているのはそれじゃない。
entries.en: ...{v:000B}But that's not what I meant.

entries.jp: {v:000C}えっと‥‥、バーンシュタイン王国の兵隊さんが{n}いるって言ってたよね。
entries.en: {v:000C}Um... He said there were soldiers from the Kingdom of{n}Burnstein here, didn't he?

entries.jp: {v:000D}ああ、思い出した！確かにそう言ってた！
entries.en: {v:000D}Oh, now I remember! He did say that!

entries.jp: {v:000E}そうだ。{n}なぜバーンシュタイン兵がランザック王国の街に{n}いるのか？
entries.en: {v:000E}Right. Why are Burnstein soldiers in a town in the{n}Kingdom of Ranzak?

entries.jp: {v:000F}う～ん、何だっけ？
entries.en: {v:000F}Hmm... What was it again?

entries.jp: {v:0010}う～ん、何だっけ？
entries.en: {v:0010}Hmm... What was it again?

entries.jp: {v:0011}えっと‥‥、この街にバーンシュタインの兵隊さんが{n}いるって話だと思う。
entries.en: {v:0011}Um... I think he means what the guard said about{n}Burnstein soldiers being in this town.

entries.jp: {v:0012}ああ、思い出した！確かにそう言ってた！
entries.en: {v:0012}Oh, now I remember! He did say that!

entries.jp: {v:0013}俺たちと同じ目的で、ここへ来ているのかも知れん。{n}バーンシュタイン王国だって敵は減らしておきたい{n}はずだからな。
entries.en: {v:0013}They may be here for the same reason we are.{n}Burnstein would want fewer enemies too.

entries.jp: {v:0014}手遅れだったのでしょうか？
entries.en: {v:0014}Were we too late?

entries.jp: {v:0015}それじゃ、手遅れ？
entries.en: {v:0015}So, we're too late?

entries.jp: {v:0016}手遅れだったということなのか？
entries.en: {v:0016}Does that mean we were too late?

entries.jp: {v:0017}まだ何とも言えんが‥‥。{p}{v:0018}せっかくここまで来たんだ。{n}連中の行動を探るところから始めてもいいだろう。
entries.en: {v:0017}Can't say for sure yet...{p}{v:0018}We've come all this way. Might as well start by finding{n}out what they're up to.

entries.jp: ここから東が、ガラシールズの街だ。
entries.en: The town of Galashiels is east of here.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:00EB}すまん、ちょっと話があるんだ。{n}宿にでも行かないか？
entries.en: ...{v:00EB}Sorry, there's something I need to talk about. How{n}about we head to the inn?

entries.jp: {v:00EC}どうかしたの？
entries.en: {v:00EC}Is something wrong?

entries.jp: {v:0025}ここから先へ行くには通行証が必要だぞ。{n}通行証を持っていない者を通すことは出来ない。
entries.en: {v:0025}You'll need a pass to go any farther. I can't let anyone{n}through without one.

entries.jp: この手形は、この街までのものだ。{n}ここより先へ通すわけにはいかん。
entries.en: This permit only allows you to travel as far as this{n}town. I can't let you go beyond here.

entries.jp: 何がしたいんだ？{n}用がないなら戻れ！
entries.en: What do you want? If you've got no business here,{n}turn back!

entries.jp: {v:001A}お前ら！{n}ここで何してるんだ？
entries.en: {v:001A}You lot! What are you doing here?

entries.jp: {v:001B}あらゼノス。{n}お久しぶり。{p}{v:001C}ゼノスこそ何してるの？
entries.en: {v:001B}Oh, Xenos! Long time no see.{p}{v:001C}What are YOU doing here?

entries.jp: {v:001D}俺か？{n}ランザック王国が傭兵を募ってるって聞いてな。
entries.en: {v:001D}Me? I heard Ranzak was recruiting mercenary troops.
{v:001E}Mercenary troops?!

entries.jp: {v:001F}ローランディア王国とバーンシュタイン王国が{n}戦争を始めちまったからな。{n}戦争の飛び火に備えるためだろ。
entries.en: {v:001F}Rolandia and Burnstein have gone to war, after all.{n}They're probably preparing in case the fighting{n}spreads here.

entries.jp: {v:0020}それで、ランザック王国の傭兵になるの？
entries.en: {v:0020}So, are you going to become a mercenary for Ranzak?

entries.jp: {v:0021}いいや、まだ時間があるから、{n}ちょっとぶらついているところだ。{n}とりあえず話を聞いて、それから決めるさ。
entries.en: {v:0021}Nah, there's still time, so I'm just wandering around{n}for now. I'll hear what they've got to say, then decide.

entries.jp: {v:0022}そうなんだ。{n}それじゃ、がんばってね！
entries.en: {v:0022}I see. Well, good luck!

entries.jp: {v:0023}ああ。{n}そっちもな。
entries.en: {v:0023}Yeah. You too.

entries.jp: こう‥‥ドカンともうかる話ってねぇかな？
entries.en: Isn't there some way to make... a whole heap of money{n}at once?

entries.jp: {v:0024}ここは立ち入り禁止だ！{n}さっさと立ち去れ！
entries.en: {v:0024}This area's off limits! Get out of here!

entries.jp: おい。{n}これ以上進むのはまずいぞ。{n}俺の顔を見られるかもしれん。
entries.en: Hey. We'd better not go any farther. Someone might see{n}my face.

entries.jp: {v:0073}まだ立ってるよ。{n}あの警備してる人をどうにかしないと{n}あの向こうを調べられないね。
{v:0074}それじゃ、ルイセちゃん、お願いね。
entries.en: {v:0074}All right, Luise-chan. We're counting on you.

entries.jp: {v:0076}あ、あの‥‥すみません。
entries.en: {v:0076}U-um... Excuse me.
{v:0077}What's wrong?

entries.jp: {v:0078}あっちでケンカをしている人がいるんです！{n}早く止めないと‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0078}There are people fighting over there! Someone has to{n}stop them, quickly...

entries.jp: {v:0079}しょうがないな。{n}案内しなさい！
entries.en: {v:0079}Oh, all right. Show me where!

entries.jp: {v:007A}はい、こっちです‥‥。
entries.en: {v:007A}Yes, this way...

entries.jp: {v:007B}やったわね。{n}さ、今のうちよ！
entries.en: {v:007B}It worked! Come on, now's our chance!

entries.jp: {v:007C}それじゃ、ミーシャ、任せたわよ。
entries.en: {v:007C}All right, Misha. It's up to you!

entries.jp: {v:007D}まーかせて！
entries.en: {v:007D}Leave it to meee!
...{v:0080}What is it?

entries.jp: {v:0081}ああ、おじさん！{n}このあたりに道具屋さんはありませんか？
entries.en: {v:0081}Oh, mister! Is there an item shop around here?

entries.jp: {v:0082}道具屋？{n}こんな外れの方にあるわけがないだろう。{p}{v:0083}もっと市街地へ行け。
entries.en: {v:0082}An item shop? Of course there isn't one this far out{n}of town.{p}{v:0083}Head farther into town.

entries.jp: {v:0084}えぇっ？{n}市街地ってこっちじゃないんですか？
entries.en: {v:0084}Huh?! Isn't town this way?

entries.jp: {v:0085}さっき、人に聞いた通りに歩いてきたんですけど‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0085}I followed the directions someone gave me{n}earlier, though...

entries.jp: {v:0086}どうやったらこんな所まで来るんだ？{n}とにかく今来た道をもどれ。
entries.en: {v:0086}How did you end up all the way out here? Just go back{n}the way you came.

entries.jp: {v:0087}聞いた通りに、歩いているつもりなんですけど‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0087}I thought I was following the directions I was given...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0088}それじゃ、あっちかなぁ‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0088}Then maybe it's that way...

entries.jp: {v:0089}バカッ！{n}そっちじゃないだろ！
entries.en: {v:0089}You idiot! Not that way!

entries.jp: {v:008A}えっ？{n}だってアタシ、こっちから歩いてきたはず‥‥。
entries.en: {v:008A}Huh? But I'm sure I came from this way...

entries.jp: {v:008B}ああ、わかった、わかった！{n}途中まで一緒に行ってやる！
entries.en: {v:008B}Oh, fine, fine! I'll walk you part of the way!

entries.jp: {v:008C}ありがとう！{n}おじさん！
entries.en: {v:008C}Thank you, mister!

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:008D}み、見事だわ‥‥。{n}とても演技には思えないけど‥‥。{p}{v:008E}さ、とにかく今のうちに先へ進みましょ！
entries.en: {FB00}{v:008D}I-impressive... Though I really don't think she{n}was acting...{p}{v:008E}Anyway, let's get moving while we can!

entries.jp: {v:008F}それじゃ、アリオストさん。{n}お願いね。
entries.en: {v:008F}All right, Ariost-san. We're counting on you.

entries.jp: {v:0090}ああ、任せておきな。
entries.en: {v:0090}Sure, leave it to me.

entries.jp: {v:0091}すみません！
entries.en: {v:0091}Excuse me!
{v:0092}Hm? What is it?

entries.jp: {v:0093}ちょっと道を聞きたいんですが？
entries.en: {v:0093}Could I ask you for directions?
{v:0094}Directions?

entries.jp: {v:0095}はい。{n}この辺りに珍しい鉱石を取り扱っているお店が{n}あると聞いたのですが？
entries.en: {v:0095}Yes. I heard there was a shop around here that sells{n}rare minerals?

entries.jp: {v:0096}そんな店はしらんな。{n}もっと街中で聞いてみろ。
entries.en: {v:0096}Never heard of a shop like that. Ask farther{n}into town.
{v:0097}O-oh, I see...

entries.jp: {v:0098}すまない。{n}ダメだったよ。
entries.en: {v:0098}Sorry. It didn't work.
{v:0099}Whaaat?

entries.jp: {v:009A}どうやら僕には向いてないみたいだ。{n}他の人に頼んでみてくれ。{p}{v:009B}それじゃ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:009A}It seems I'm not cut out for this. Try asking{n}someone else.{p}{v:009B}Well, then...

entries.jp: {v:009C}別の人を探すしかないわね。
entries.en: {v:009C}Guess we'll have to find someone else.

entries.jp: {v:009D}それじゃ、カレンさん。{n}お願いしますね。
entries.en: {v:009D}All right, Karen-san. We're counting on you.

entries.jp: {v:009E}はい。がんばります。
entries.en: {v:009E}Yes. I'll do my best.

entries.jp: {v:009F}どうも、お疲れさまです‥‥。
entries.en: {v:009F}Hello. Thank you for all your hard work...

entries.jp: {v:00A0}あ、ああ、どうも。
entries.en: {v:00A0}O-oh, thank you.

entries.jp: {v:00A2}どうしたんですか？
entries.en: {v:00A2}What's wrong?

entries.jp: ‥{v:00A3}すみません、体が弱いもので‥‥うぅ‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:00A3}I'm sorry. I've never been very strong... Ooh...

entries.jp: {v:00A4}しっかりしろ！おい！
entries.en: {v:00A4}Hang on! Hey!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:00A5}すみません、宿まで肩を貸して{n}いただけないでしょうか‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:00A5}I'm sorry, but could you help me walk back to{n}the inn...?

entries.jp: {v:00A6}ああ、だからしっかりするんだ。
entries.en: {v:00A6}Yes, just hang in there.

entries.jp: {v:00A7}さすが、大人の魅力ね。{p}{v:00A8}さ、今のうちに進みましょっ！
entries.en: {v:00A7}That's a grown woman's charm for you!{p}{v:00A8}Come on, let's get moving while we can!

entries.jp: ちょっと！{n}せっかくのチャンスを無駄にスル気？
entries.en: Hey! Are you going to waste this chance?!

entries.jp: せっかくここまで来て、手ぶらで帰る気！？
entries.en: We came all this way, and you're going{n}back empty-handed?!

entries.jp: 早くみんなの所へ戻ろうよ！
entries.en: Let's hurry back to everyone!

entries.jp: {v:00A9}ここにも警備をしてる兵隊がいるよ？{p}{v:00AA}あの屋敷で何をしてるのかな？{n}アタシ、ちょっと見てくるよ。{p}{v:00AB}あの屋敷の煙突から入れば、{n}気付かれずに様子を探れると思うんだ。
entries.en: {v:00A9}There's a soldier standing guard here too!{p}{v:00AA}What are they doing in that mansion? I'll go take{n}a peek.{p}{v:00AB}I bet I can slip down the chimney and find out what's{n}going on without anyone noticing.
{v:00AC}Eeeek!

entries.jp: {v:00AD}風が強くて、飛べないよぉ‥‥。{p}{v:00EE}やっぱり、アンタと一緒に行かなきゃダメみたい。{p}{v:00AE}屋根の所まで連れてってよ！{n}そこまで行けたら、煙突を通って、{n}中の様子を見てくるから。
entries.en: {v:00AD}The wind's too strong! I can't flyyy...{p}{v:00EE}Looks like I'll have to go with you after all.{p}{v:00AE}Take me up to the roof! Once I'm there, I'll go down the{n}chimney and see what's happening inside.

entries.jp: {FFEE}見張りに発見されず、煙突までたどりつけ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Reach the chimney without being spotted by the{n}guards!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FD00}{FD01}{v:00B7}ここを足場にすれば、屋根まで登れそうだよ。
entries.en: {FD00}{FD01}{v:00B7}You should be able to climb up to the roof if you use{n}this as a foothold.

entries.jp: {v:00B8}やったね。{n}それじゃ、中の様子を見てくるから。{p}{v:00B9}アンタは今の間に外まで戻っててね！
entries.en: {v:00B8}We did it! I'll go see what's happening inside.{p}{v:00B9}You head back outside while I'm in there!

entries.jp: {v:00B5}まったく、下手ねぇ‥‥。{p}{FC00}{v:00B6}あ、風が弱まってきたみたい。{n}アタシが１人で行って来るよ！
entries.en: {v:00B5}Honestly, you're terrible at this...{p}{FC00}{v:00B6}Oh, looks like the wind's dying down. I'll go on my own!

entries.jp: {v:00B1}今度は見つからないようにね！
entries.en: {v:00B1}Don't let them spot you this time!

entries.jp: {v:00B4}今度こそ見つからないようにね！
entries.en: {v:00B4}Make SURE they don't spot you this time!

entries.jp: {v:00AF}こらっ！{n}ここは子供の遊び場所じゃないぞ！{p}{v:00B0}さぁ、帰るんだ！
entries.en: {v:00AF}Hey! This is no place for kids to play!{p}{v:00B0}Go on, get out of here!

entries.jp: {v:00B2}こらっ！{n}またお前か！{p}{v:00B3}子供は帰った、帰った！
entries.en: {v:00B2}Hey! You again!{p}{v:00B3}Go home, kid! Go on!

entries.jp: {v:00BA}しかし、互いに歳を取ったものだな。{n}昔はもっと‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00BA}We've both grown old, haven't we? Back in the day, we{n}were more...

entries.jp: {v:00BB}無駄話をしに来たわけではあるまい。{n}さっさと本題に入れ。
entries.en: {v:00BB}You didn't come here to make small talk. Get to{n}the point.

entries.jp: {v:00BC}いまだにその堅苦しい性格は直らんか。
entries.en: {v:00BC}Still as stiff as ever, I see.

entries.jp: {v:00BD}大きなお世話だ。
entries.en: {v:00BD}That's none of your concern.

entries.jp: {v:00BE}ふん。
entries.en: {v:00BE}Hmph.

entries.jp: {v:00BF}我々、バーンシュタイン王国は国境の森を抜け、{n}間もなくローランディア王国と交戦する。{p}{v:00C0}その間にお前たちランザック王国は{n}ローランディア王国の背後に回り込み‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00BF}We of Burnstein will pass through the forest on the{n}border and soon engage Rolandia's forces.{p}{v:00C0}Meanwhile, your Ranzak forces will move around{n}behind Rolandia...

entries.jp: {v:00C1}作戦の確認はいい。
entries.en: {v:00C1}There's no need to go over the plan.

entries.jp: {v:00C2}ならばランザック王国としての答えを聞こうか？{p}{v:00C3}この挟撃作戦に協力するのか？{n}それともしないのか？
entries.en: {v:00C2}Then shall I hear Ranzak's answer?{p}{v:00C3}Will you cooperate in this pincer attack, or won't you?

entries.jp: {v:00C4}すでに出撃の準備は出来ている。{n}本当にバーンシュタイン王国が{n}我が国に攻め込まないと言うのであれば‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00C4}We are already prepared to march. If Burnstein truly{n}will refrain from invading our country...

entries.jp: {v:00C5}それは約束しよう。{n}お前と俺の仲ではないか。{n}信じろ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00C5}You have my word. You and I go way back. Trust me...

entries.jp: {v:00C6}かつての友とは言え、{n}お前は団長なき傭兵団を見捨てて、{n}自分のために生きた男だ。{p}{v:00C7}あれから俺が部下を養うためにした苦労など、{n}想像も出来んだろうな。
entries.en: {v:00C6}We may have been friends once, but you abandoned our{n}mercenary company when we lost our captain and{n}went off to live for yourself.{p}{v:00C7}You couldn't begin to imagine what I went through to{n}keep my men fed after that.

entries.jp: {v:00C8}そう言うな。{p}{v:00C9}もし俺がいたら、もっと苦労していたかもしれんぞ？{n}お前と俺は、水と油だからな。{p}{v:00CA}それに１人で苦労した原因を{n}俺だけに求めるのはどうかと思うが？
entries.en: {v:00C8}Don't be like that.{p}{v:00C9}If I'd stayed, I might have made things even harder{n}for you. You and I are like oil and water.{p}{v:00CA}Besides, am I really the only one to blame for leaving{n}you to struggle alone?

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:00CB}ウォレスか。{p}{v:00CC}話がそれたようだな。{n}本題に戻ろう。
entries.en: ...{v:00CB}Wallace.{p}{v:00CC}We've strayed from the subject. Let's get back{n}to business.

entries.en: You're merchants dealing in magical tools, you say?{n}Well, there might be a few people interested in those.{p}Rumor has it that a master of magic moved here.{n}Magic's gradually begun spreading through this{n}country, too.

entries.jp: あんたら、ランザックの者じゃないね？{n}あの迷いの森を通ってくるとは、{n}物好きな人もいるもんだね。{p}昔、あの森に入ったものは、{n}２度と出てくることはなかったそうだ。{n}他にも変な言い伝えがあったような‥‥。{p}　『白き光を放ちて、左へと回れ。{n}　　　さすれば扉は開かれん‥‥』{n}だったかな？{p}とにかくあの森には近寄らん方がいい。{n}くわばらくわばら‥‥。
entries.en: You're not from Ranzak, are you? Coming all the way{n}through the Lost Forest... Some people have the{n}strangest ideas.{p}They say that long ago, anyone who entered that{n}forest never came out again. There was another{n}strange old saying, too...{p}'Send forth a white light and turn to the left. Then{n}shall the door open...' Was that how it went?{p}Anyway, you'd best keep away from that forest.{n}Heaven preserve us...

entries.jp: とにかく迷いの森には近寄らん方がいい。{n}くわばらくわばら‥‥。

{v:0047}You're right.
{v:0048}Yes, I think so.

entries.en: {v:004F}How should I go about this...?

entries.jp: {v:0050}行ってきます。
entries.en: {v:0050}I'll be off, then.

entries.jp: {v:0051}さ、アタシ達も行きましょ！
entries.en: {v:0051}Come on, let's get going, too!

entries.jp: すまない。{n}俺は情報収集に出かけられん。
entries.en: Sorry. I can't go out gathering information.

entries.jp: {v:00D6}お兄ちゃん達はどうだった？
entries.en: {v:00D6}How did things go for you, Big Brother?

entries.jp: {v:00D7}それが、大変なの！
entries.en: {v:00D7}We're in big trouble!

entries.jp: {v:00D8}詳しく話してみろ。
entries.en: {v:00D8}Tell me exactly what happened.
{v:00D9}Well, here's what happened...

entries.jp: {v:00DB}ガムランとウェーバーが‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00DB}Gamlan and Weber...

entries.jp: {v:00DC}それより早く何とかしないと！
entries.en: {v:00DC}We've got to do something, and fast!

entries.jp: {v:00DD}連中の話からすると、{n}迷いの森を通過して攻め込むらしいな。{p}{v:00DE}確かに森の中は入り組んでいるから、{n}ローランディア、バーンシュタインの両軍隊が{n}ぶつかっている間に背後を突くことが可能だ。
entries.en: {v:00DD}From what they said, they plan to attack through the{n}Lost Forest.{p}{v:00DE}The paths through that forest twist and turn. They{n}could strike from behind while Rolandia and Burnstein's{n}armies are fighting.

entries.jp: {v:00DF}どうするの？{n}このままじゃ、ランザックと同盟を結ぶどころか、{n}ローランディアが負けちゃうかも知れないじゃない！
entries.en: {v:00DF}What are we going to do? Forget an alliance with{n}Ranzak--at this rate, Rolandia might lose the war!

entries.jp: {v:00E0}それでは、どうする？{n}このままでは、ランザックと同盟を結ぶどころか、{n}下手をするとローランディアが負けるかもしれない。
entries.en: {v:00E0}What do we do, then? At this rate, an alliance with{n}Ranzak is out of the question. Rolandia might even lose{n}the war.

entries.jp: {v:00E1}それでは、私たちはどうすれば良いのでしょう？{p}{v:00E2}このままでは同盟どころか、{n}ローランディアが負けてしまうかもしれませんよ？
entries.en: {v:00E1}Then what should we do?{p}{v:00E2}At this rate, we may not just fail to secure an{n}alliance. Rolandia could lose the war.

entries.jp: {v:00E3}俺たちで何とかこれを止める方法はないのか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00E3}Isn't there some way we can stop this...?

entries.jp: ウォレスさんを放っておいて、どこ行くつもりよ！
entries.en: Where do you think you're going, leaving{n}Wallace-san behind?!
